name: Azure Terraform
postCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends graphviz libgvplugin-neato-layout8 jq shellcheck && sudo dot -c && pip install --user --no-cache-dir checkov terravision terraformgraph && npm install -g prettier cspell && sudo bash <(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rhysd/actionlint/main/scripts/download-actionlint.bash) latest /usr/local/bin && GITLEAKS_TAG=$(curl -fsSLI -o /dev/null -w '%{url_effective}' https://github.com/gitleaks/gitleaks/releases/latest | awk -F'/' '{print $NF}') && GITLEAKS_VER=${GITLEAKS_TAG#v} && [ $(uname -m) = x86_64 ] && G_ARCH=x64 || G_ARCH=arm64 && curl -fsSL https://github.com/gitleaks/gitleaks/releases/download/${GITLEAKS_TAG}/gitleaks_${GITLEAKS_VER}_linux_${G_ARCH}.tar.gz | sudo tar -xz -C /usr/local/bin gitleaks && curl -sfL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/aquasecurity/trivy/main/contrib/install.sh | sudo sh -s -- -b /usr/local/bin && curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/infracost/infracost/master/scripts/install.sh | sh && (chmod +x .githooks/* scripts/*.sh scripts/*/*.sh 2>/dev/null || true) && git config core.hooksPath .githooks && (tflint --init || true)
